name: N3-tree with regular mipmapped bricks
definition: A two-level hierarchical structure for procedural volume exploration combining an N3-tree (an N-ary tree with N^3 children) for hierarchy and regular voxel bricks stored in the leaves. It links the compactness of a hierarchical structure with the efficient traversal and trilinear/quadrilinear filtering capabilities of regular grids on GPU.
summary: The N3-tree with regular mipmapped bricks is a two-level hierarchical data structure for procedural volume exploration that combines an N-ary tree with regular voxel bricks to enable efficient GPU traversal and filtering.
